properties.name: MEASURED 2026-09-26 on 0.71.0: re-calling record_finding on an existing fact with only id, subject_id and valid_to reset its fact_type from "status" to "finding", despite "omitted fields keep their stored value"
properties.source: dev_reflow2 hub session, 2026-09-26, reflow2-mcp 0.71.0 (the child-reflow2 connection)
properties.statement:
Closing fact:the-tier-deferral-is-due-to-be-re-asked-2026-09-26 (stored fact_type "status"), the call record_finding {id, subject_id, valid_to: "2026-09-26"} came back with valid_to set AND fact_type "finding". fact_type had not been passed. The tool's own description says "CONTENT FIELDS ARE REQUIRED TO CREATE AND OPTIONAL TO REVISE … omitted fields keep their stored value", and this check claims re-calling a constructor does not erase what the design knew. So at least fact_type is defaulted on revise rather than kept. The other fields (basis, confidence, name, source, statement, valid_from) were kept. Put back with a second call passing fact_type "status". Same class as the plan_epoch status reset (fact:plan-epoch-on-an-existing-epoch-resets-its-status-to-planned), which was fixed for epochs. Not root-caused: whether the default comes from the tool's parameter default or the store's merge was not read.

UPDATE 2026-09-28 (triage of art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27): RECURRED in dev_storyflow on 2026-09-25 (defect → finding on a name + statement revise). ROOT-CAUSED in fact:root-cause-record-finding-writes-its-defaults-on-every-revise-2026-09-28. The default comes from the TOOL, not the store's merge: record_finding writes `unwrap_or("finding")` / `unwrap_or("measured")` into the upsert on every call. Reproduced on 0.72.0, where `basis` also resets (forecast → measured). Still present in current source.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #624 (squash 8588b7a), pinned by a_revise_keeps_what_it_was_not_passed.rs. Its change record, chg:a-revise-keeps-what-it-was-not-passed (which INVALIDATES this fact in the committed design), is not in this live store. The live server still runs 0.74.0 until a cut and rebuild.
